items.name: AI and data analytics for water science
items.blurb: My current research at Western Sydney University: applying AI and data analytics to water science.

items.name: Australia India Water Centre
items.blurb: A bilateral centre hosted at Western Sydney University, connecting research, education and training on water across Australia and India. I rebuilt the Centre's website as a single self-contained page.

items.name: Learning hard graph instances for Maximum Independent Set
items.blurb: Deep reinforcement learning with GraphSAGE to automatically discover graph patterns that produce hard instances for Maximum Independent Set solvers. The useful output is not a better solver but a generator of the inputs that make existing ones struggle.

items.name: aSwam — adaptive firefighting drone swarm
items.blurb: A reinforcement learning model for a drone swarm that coordinates to fight spreading fires, where the policy has to adapt as the fire front changes rather than follow a fixed assignment.
